articles.제목: Russian regulator considers licence for Zaporizhzhia unit 3
articles.원문 요약: A Rostekhnadzor commission has begun work at the Zaporizhzhia Nuclear Power Plant to review material submitted in support of an operating licence application for unit 3.

Energy crisis reinforces comeback of nuclear power, says IEA
articles.원문 요약: Unprecedented disruption in the energy world - primarily resulting from the war in the Middle East - is set to reinforce the comeback of nuclear power, according to the International Energy Agency's latest World Energy Outlook, which has revised its forecast for nuclear upwards.

articles.제목: Samsung, Tesser to collaborate on nuclear-powered LNG carrier
articles.원문 요약: South Korean shipbuilder Samsung Heavy Industries and US nuclear technology company Tesser Atomics have entered into an exclusive strategic collaboration on a demonstration project for a transatlantic nuclear-powered liquefied natural gas carrier.

articles.제목: Hot and cold testing under way for Turkey's Akkuyu 1
articles.원문 요약: The first nuclear power reactor in Turkey has moved a step closer to start-up, with hot and cold commissioning tests taking place.

articles.제목: Bulgaria's NEK signs MoU for potential BWRX-300 projects
articles.원문 요약: State-owned electricity company Natsionalna Elektricheska Kompania has signed a memorandum of understanding with Poland's SGE and Blue Bird Energy to cooperate on the deployment of BWRX-300 small modular reactors in Bulgaria.

articles.제목: New nuclear projects offer economic advantages for Ontario
articles.원문 요약: Four major nuclear projects could bring billions of dollars of economic benefits to Ontario and to Canada - but government and industry need to act now to turn the nuclear buildout into a lasting industrial advantage, according to a report from the national body representing Canada's manufacturing sector.
